name: Wailing Essence
summary: Wailing Essence is a strange, concentrated substance found within the ectoplasms roaming deep inside the Wailing Caverns. Suspected of fueling the bizarre mutations spreading through the flora and fauna of the Barrens, it has drawn the attention of opportunistic alchemists eager to bottle its potent properties.

sections.title: A Volatile Concoction
sections.body: The subterranean caverns beneath the central Barrens have grown thick with unnatural energy, warping beasts and giving rise to gelatinous ectoplasms. These oozing creatures concentrate a viscous substance known as Wailing Essence. While local druids observe these waters with growing dread, goblin entrepreneurs see only raw commercial opportunity. In the port town of Ratchet, an eccentric alchemist named Mebok Mizzyrix believes this essence is the missing active ingredient for a line of lucrative 'smart drinks' meant to enhance consumer intellect, utterly unconcerned with the nightmarish corruption it might actually harbor.

faq.q: Where does Wailing Essence come from?
faq.answer: It is gathered from the ectoplasmic slimes inside the Wailing Caverns, including devouring ectoplasms, evolving ectoplasms, and nightmare ectoplasms.
Mebok Mizzyrix, a goblin experimenter located in Ratchet, seeks the essence to brew a new formula of his intellect-boosting 'smart drinks.'

faq.q: What is the essence suspected of doing to the Barrens?
faq.answer: Mebok suspects that the essence is the root cause behind the rapidly mutating wildlife and unnatural plant overgrowth observed spreading across the Barrens.

faq.q: Is drinking Wailing Essence actually safe?
faq.answer: Given that it is extracted from corrupt, nightmare-tainted ectoplasms deep in a cursed cavern, consuming it in a commercial beverage is reckless at best, though typical for goblin entrepreneurial standards.

angles.text: The existence of this essence points directly to the corrupting influence deep inside the Wailing Caverns, underscoring the urgent need to cleanse the Dream's taint.
